messages.S2や守備でS1「待て！」を捨ててパネルを入れ替え、ランクの高いS2「引き裂く」: Use S2 or defense to discard S1 Wait Up! and cycle the dashboard, repeatedly using the higher-rank S2 Slice and S3 Daring Decision. She triggers many Tremor Bursts but relies on allies to apply the enemy's Tremor.
messages.スキルを捨てる: S2と守備「二日酔いの解消」は、使用時に自分の全スキルスロット: **Discarding skills**: On use, S2 and the Defense skill Hangover Cure discard the lowest-rank skill from all of her skill slots. On use, S3 discards all skills in descending order of rank (skills not used that turn). The Defense skill's discard happens on use, so it does not trigger unless she is attacked.
messages.S1「待て！」は捨てて得をする: 捨てられると自分の振動回数+4(低い同期化段階: **S1 Wait Up! pays off when discarded**: When discarded, her Tremor Count increases by 4 (+3 at lower Uptie). S2 only grants 1 Offense Level Up when discarded, so keep it as her main skill.
messages.自分の振動回数: S1の使用時に+2され、6以上でS1の最終威力+2(低い同期化: **Her own Tremor Count**: +2 on using S1, and at 6 or more, S1 gains +2 Final Power (+1 at lower Uptie). Coin Ⅲ of S2 triggers Tremor Burst on hit if her own Tremor Count is 6 or more.
messages.S3: 使用時に自分の振動回数を10消耗してコイン威力+2(低い同期化段階では+: **S3**: On use, spends 10 of her own Tremor Count for +2 Coin Power (+1 at lower Uptie). Coin Ⅰ inflicts 4 Tremor (+3 Tremor Count if she spent), and Coins Ⅱ–Ⅳ trigger Tremor Burst 3 times (each followed by −1 target Tremor Count).
messages.バトルパッシブ「武勇伝」(怠惰×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 敵に振動爆発を起こ: **Combat passive — Drinking Boast (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Each time she triggers Tremor Burst on an enemy, deals Sloth damage equal to 30% of the Stagger Threshold shift (up to 20, rounded down).
messages.サポートパッシブ「横暴と応援」(怠惰×3・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 振動回数が最: **Support passive — Carrot & Stick (3 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 to the Tremor Count that the 1 ally with the most Tremor Count gains from skill effects. It speeds up preparation for Identities that power up by spending their own Tremor Count (for example, Yi Sang's Effloresced E.G.O::Spicebush, whose S2 spends 6 of his own Tremor Count).
messages.S1がパネルに並んだら、S2や守備でS1を捨て、空いた枠にS2・S3を引き込んで: When S1s line up on the panel, discard them with S2 or her Defense skill, pulling S2 and S3 into the freed slots to use repeatedly. Each S1 discarded builds her own Tremor Count, making S2's Tremor Burst and S3's bonus conditions easier to meet. Tremor Burst's effect is determined by the target's Tremor Potency, and her own infliction is limited to S2 (2 Tremor each on Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, 1 each at lower Uptie) and S3 (4 Tremor), so pair her with allies who can stack Tremor on enemies. Note that her play changes depending on how well she can discard S1.
